entities.summary: Hpa-an is a large city in southeastern Myanmar and the capital and largest city of Kayin State. The population as of the 2014 census was 421,575, mostly of the Karen ethnic group. Hpa-An has surpassed Taunggyi as the fifth largest city in Myanmar.
